name: Novera Ahmed
contribution: She assisted in the design and sculptural vision of the central Shaheed Minar, helping define its symbolic language.
impact: Her contribution linked modern art, public memory, and Bengali nationalism.
highlight: Novera Ahmed assisted Hamidur Rahman on the early Shaheed Minar complex and completed sculptures for the memorial project.
seoTitle: Novera Ahmed: Sculptor of the Shaheed Minar Project
seoDescription: Learn about Novera Ahmed's sculptural work and collaboration on the early Shaheed Minar complex in Dhaka.
shortAnswer: Novera Ahmed was a pioneering Bangladeshi sculptor who assisted the design and construction of the early Shaheed Minar complex.
